QA.description: Structured method for generating, expanding and formalizing scientific questions into machine-readable objects.

EN.description: Method for navigating high-entropy information landscapes using uncertainty signals and divergence metrics.

RS.description: Structural verification layer grounding AI reflection in external formal systems (causal models, state machines, schema constraints).

SR.description: Governance mechanism ensuring humans retain sole interpretive authority and liability for conclusions.

entropy_high_threshold.description: Above this normalised Shannon entropy the question landscape is classified as high-entropy.

kl_novelty_threshold.description: KL divergence threshold above which a posterior distribution is deemed novel relative to the prior.

rs_grounding_threshold.description: Minimum causal-grounding score for a claim set to pass Reflective Scaffolding verification.

human_gate_min_score.description: Minimum weighted-aggregate score for the Human Validation Gate to pass.

interaction_loop_stages: HUMAN — conceptual framing, scientific intent, question architecture
AI — uncertainty exploration, entropy scanning, reflective scaffolding
SYSTEM — schema validation, pipelines, reproducible documentation
